runbooks.first_action: Validate telemetry and current release correlation.

runbooks.trigger: Unauthorized runtime or cross-tenant access signal.
runbooks.first_action: Preserve evidence and isolate the affected workflow.
Stop evidence synthesis and verify safe abstention.

runbooks.trigger: Approved model provider fails or exceeds timeout policy.
runbooks.first_action: Validate circuit-breaker state and controlled fallback eligibility.
Confirm fail-closed behavior and block runtime execution.

runbooks.trigger: Runtime concurrency or queue thresholds are exceeded.
runbooks.first_action: Stop new work and preserve existing workflow state.

runbooks.trigger: Release gate failure or post-release regression.
runbooks.first_action: Pause progression and validate the approved rollback target.

runbooks.trigger: Regional platform failure requiring recovery evaluation.
runbooks.first_action: Validate recovery evidence, RPO, RTO, and approval binding.
